index.title: Private exploratory report | Findings
index.heading: Independent findings.
index.lede: Each model is presented on its own. Results are never merged into a single verdict.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.note: Belonging to a window does not by itself make an image individual evidence.

index.findingsNote: Every finding is shown in full, including those without usable evidence, which are labelled as such.
index.evidenceButton: Open the images for this finding

readingNote.heading: The image explains the model's text. It does not validate anatomy.
readingNote.body: There are no validated coordinates or segmentations. The images are the slices the model cited, not radiologically confirmed locations.

dialog.title: Image gallery
dialog.warning: These are the slices the model cited. They are not model-provided coordinates, segmentations, or radiological confirmation.

vascular.heading: Vascular zone
vascular.panelLede: The vascular zone is an anatomical estimate derived from the position relative to the meniscocapsular margin. It is not a measurement of blood flow.
vascular.notRepairability: The zone does not determine repairability and does not support a treatment recommendation.

summary.allSame: All {total} findings are estimated in the {zone} zone.
summary.mixed: The findings are estimated across several zones.

interpretation.red_red: Conventionally regarded as a well-vascularised zone.
interpretation.red_white: Conventionally regarded as a partially vascularised zone.
interpretation.white_white: Conventionally regarded as a poorly vascularised or avascular zone.
interpretation.junctional: A transition zone between vascular territories.
interpretation.indeterminate: The vascular territory could not be estimated.

report.title: Exploratory radiology report
report.eyebrow: Document generated from the study data
report.heading: Structured report
report.lede: Text composed deterministically from the study's structured fields. It contains no model-generated prose.

header.heading: Examination
header.examinationValue: Knee MRI, exploratory analysis of the menisci

results.heading: RESULTS
results.noFindingsFor: No finding was reported for this meniscus.
results.tearNotEvaluable: the segment is not evaluable on the available images
results.surfaceIntact: no extension to the articular surfaces or the free edge
results.capsularIntact: no meniscocapsular separation and no peripheral extension
results.distance: estimated distance to the meniscocapsular margin: {value} mm ({method})
results.fragmentAbsent: no displaced fragment, flap, or bucket-handle appearance
results.fragmentDetail: stability: displaced fragment ({displaced}), flap ({flap}), bucket handle ({bucket})
results.vascular: estimated {zone} vascular zone ({basis}), without direct observation of vascularity

notAssessed.heading: NOT ASSESSED IN THIS STUDY
notAssessed.lede: The study analysed the appearance of the menisci only. The structures below were not analysed; the absence of a statement does not mean they are normal.
items: Extensor mechanism, patellar tendon and retinaculum
Trabecular bone, marrow oedema and osteochondral lesions
Hoffa's fat pad and synovial plica

conclusion.heading: CONCLUSION
conclusion.noTear: Exploratory analysis of the menisci of the {side} knee demonstrated no meniscal tear on the slices analysed.
conclusion.someTear: Exploratory analysis of the menisci of the {side} knee identified findings with a suspected tear ({count}).
conclusion.indeterminate: Findings that remain undetermined because of resolution, plane or window limitations: {count}.
conclusion.vascular: The vascular zones reported are anatomical estimates: {summary}
conclusion.traceability: Traceability: {verified} of {total} window-level findings carry verified evidence from their own window ({percent}%), with no citation outside the approved plan.
conclusion.boundary: This document is not a diagnosis, does not determine repairability, and makes no treatment recommendation.

options.title: Topics to discuss with a clinician
options.heading: Not medical advice.
options.lede: The list below contains questions you may raise with a clinician. It is not a treatment recommendation and does not follow automatically from the study results.

items.title: What this study does and does not show
items.body: The study analysed only the appearance of the menisci on the supplied images. It did not assess the ligaments, cartilage, effusion, or bone.

items.title: How certain the findings are
items.body: Each finding carries a confidence level stated by the model and a traceability label showing whether it rests on verified slices.

items.title: What the vascular zone means
items.body: It is an anatomical estimate of the position relative to the meniscocapsular margin, not a measurement of blood supply. On its own it decides nothing.

items.title: What a specialist could clarify
items.body: Correlation with the clinical examination, with symptoms, and where appropriate with additional sequences or planes.
